logline: Inside the opulent Ashbury estate, the treacherous Rupert and Catherine plot to seize the ducal title as the Dowager Duchess slowly withers, while in an icy barn, Juliana defiantly prepares remedies to save the fever-stricken villagers.
continuity_notes: Follows Episode 19's night in the barn; as Alexander begins his clandestine fight to reclaim his birthright, Juliana tends to the suffering village while Rupert and Catherine celebrate their anticipated ascension to the ducal throne.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle establishing shot tilting up toward the imposing, grand stone facade of Ashbury Manor against a cold, overcast morning sky, frost dusting the pristine lawn.

scenes.heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium wide shot of the lavish drawing room. CATHERINE, dressed in an ornate lilac regency gown and white satin gloves, gracefully pours hot tea from an ornate silver teapot, while RUPERT stands elegantly by the tall window.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Smug, Prim)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Two lumps of sugar, Rupert?

segments.label: CATHERINE (Taunting, Silkily)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Or has your sudden climb to power sweetened your taste already?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine stirring her tea with a silver spoon, lifting her gaze with a haughty smirk.

segments.label: RUPERT (Flirtatious, Sly)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: Only if it sweetens your disposition, Catherine.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot tracking Rupert as he steps forward from the hearth, adjusting his dark leather gloves with an air of absolute triumph.

segments.label: RUPERT (Boastful, Confident)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: The estate is practically ours.

segments.label: RUPERT (Smug)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: The succession papers are being finalized as we speak.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Catherine raising the porcelain teacup to her lips, her expression turning sharp and dismissive.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Cold, Haughty)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: 'Practically' is a word for beggars. I do not marry a practical Duke.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Stern, Ambitious)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: I marry the Lord of Ashbury.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Rupert striding toward the tea table, leaning forward with predatory conviction.

segments.label: RUPERT (Reassuring, Firm)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: And so you shall.

segments.label: RUPERT (Dark, Conspiratorial)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown...

segments.label: RUPERT (Decisive)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: ...the title is mine.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine lowering her teacup, her icy blue eyes narrowing in calculated concern.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Wary, Inquiring)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: And what of the Dowager? The old woman still breathes.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Disdainful)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Her shadow still hangs over this house.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Rupert's face as a sinister grin spreads across his features.

segments.label: RUPERT (Quiet, Sinister)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: Her health fails more each day. The physicians are baffled.

segments.label: RUPERT (Gloating)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: They call it a wasting of the lungs.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up side profile of Catherine bringing the teacup to her lips, savoring his words with chilling detachment.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Mock-Sympathetic, Cruel)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: How tragic. The slow, quiet decline.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Scheming)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: How much longer can the frail thing survive?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium profile of Rupert looking out the window, hands clasped behind him.

segments.label: RUPERT (Cold, Callous)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: Not through the winter. I've ensured her quiet comfort.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine turning her head toward the window, her lips curled in venomous disgust.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Vindictive)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Good. The village is already whispering about her.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Contemptuous)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: The local peasants are like dogs, barking at every carriage that passes.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Disgusted)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: They disgust me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot. Rupert stands over Catherine seated at the polished table, placing a gloved hand possessively near her shoulder.

segments.label: RUPERT (Dismissive, Arrogant)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: They are nothing. Dirt beneath our boots.

segments.label: RUPERT (Authoritative, Promising)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: They will learn their place when you wear the ducal crown.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up tilting down on JULIANA kneeling in the straw beside a rustic wooden crate, sorting sprigs of dried lavender and sage into a woven basket. Her hands are bound in linen bandages from the recent fire.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The barn door opens, revealing daylight outside. SEAMUS, an older weathered villager in a waistcoat, carries a wooden bucket inside, his expression etched with deep sorrow and concern.

segments.label: SEAMUS (Gentle, Concerned)
segments.speaker: SEAMUS
segments.text: Let me take that basket, Lady Juliana.

segments.label: SEAMUS (Empathetic)
segments.speaker: SEAMUS
segments.text: Your palms are still raw from the fire. You shouldn't be working in this freezing draft.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Seamus reaches down to take the handle of the basket from her.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up at Seamus, her smudged face fierce with unyielding determination as she holds firmly onto the basket.

segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce, Resolute)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: If I stop, Seamus, the lung fever in the valley wins.

segments.label: JULIANA (Defiant)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I do not yield to a cold draft.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Seamus, his face agonizingly strained with grief for her lost status.

segments.label: SEAMUS (Desperate, Grieving)
segments.speaker: SEAMUS
segments.text: You are a viscount's daughter!

segments.label: SEAMUS (Pleading)
segments.speaker: SEAMUS
segments.text: Sleeping on straw, sorting weeds!

segments.label: SEAMUS (Frustrated)
segments.speaker: SEAMUS
segments.text: Let the village tend to itself for once!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana, her jaw set with unwavering moral strength.

segments.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Unflinching)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: The chapel is gone, Seamus. I am the only healer these people have left.

segments.label: JULIANA (Unyielding)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I keep the basket.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot of Juliana and Seamus standing facing each other in the barn, the lantern casting a warm amber glow between them.

segments.label: SEAMUS (Saddened, Heartbroken)
segments.speaker: SEAMUS
segments.text: They have reduced you to a peasant.

segments.label: JULIANA (Proud, Indomitable)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: They have reduced me to myself.

segments.label: JULIANA (Steely)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: And I am not finished.

scenes.heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Catherine's gloved hand sets her fine porcelain teacup down onto the silver tray with a delicate clatter.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Sharp porcelain chime of teacup meeting saucer.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine looking up, her face twisting into venomous arrogance.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Callous)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Let the peasants rot in their barns.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Mocking, Spiteful)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Let them pray to their weeds.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as Rupert steps around the mahogany table and leans close into Catherine's ear, smiling seductively.

segments.label: RUPERT (Intimate, Reassuring)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: You have no rival here, Catherine.

segments.label: RUPERT (Fawning)
segments.speaker: RUPERT
segments.text: No one to stand in your way.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine looking into Rupert's eyes, her smile turning predatory and cold.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Triumphant, Greedy)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Once the old Duchess is gone...

segments.label: CATHERINE (Possessive)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: ...Ashbury will finally belong to us.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Catherine rises from her chair in one regal motion and glides toward the towering window overlooking the vast estate grounds.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tracking medium shot following Catherine from behind as she walks gracefully to the window frame, the grey morning light outlining her aristocratic silhouette.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Cold, Ruthless)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: This house will only bow to me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up profile of Catherine gazing out the windowpane, her icy eyes burning with insatiable ambition as dramatic strings swell to a menacing cliffhanger hold.
